items.title: Tech, mining rally lifts ASX200
items.summary: The ASX 200 has surged 87 points as mining and technology stocks rebounded, following a Wall Street recovery that steadied global markets after a turbulent week.

items.title: Nasdaq Posts Worst Weekly Drop in Months as Dow Edges to a Narrow Gain
items.summary: Stock Preachers News Commentary - Wall Street closed a volatile week split sharply down the middle. The Dow finished Friday at 52,134.63, down 0.08% on the day but still up 0.93% for the week, while the Nasdaq Composite tumbled 1.28% Friday and 3.64% for the week, its worst stretch in months. The S&P 500 fell 1.43% weekly and the Russell 2000 dropped 2.43%. items.title: PLS Group shares rise 3% as it approves $1.3 billion lithium expansion
items.summary: Investing.com -- Pls Group (ASX:PLS) shares rose 3% on Friday after the Australian lithium producer approved a $1.3 billion expansion of its Pilgangoora operation in Western Australia, paving the way to nearly double its spodumene concentrate production capacity by 2029.

aus.headline: ASX 200 Jumps 87 Points
aus.body: Miners and tech names led the ASX 200 up 87 points after Wall Street steadied.
aus.why: Most Australians own ASX shares through their super.

us.headline: Nasdaq Has Worst Week In Months
us.body: The Nasdaq lost 3.64% over the week, while the Dow ended the week up 0.93%.
us.why: Many Australians hold US tech shares through super.

biz.headline: PLS Backs $1.3b Lithium Growth
biz.body: PLS approved a $1.3b expansion at Pilgangoora in WA, and its shares rose 3%.
biz.why: It could nearly double output at a major WA lithium mine.
